title: Migration redeem has no nonce/spent-marker; proof+signature replayable
description: L2ContractMigrationFacet.redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances is an external, permissionless function (only nonReentrant). It authenticates a migration by (1) MerkleProof.verify over leaf=keccak256(account,deposits,internalBalances,ownerRoots) against a hardcoded MERKLE_ROOT, and (2) an EIP-712 signature over (owner,reciever,deadline) recovered with ECDSA.recover and required to equal owner. Neither check consumes any state: there is no nonce, no per-leaf/per-signature redeemed-marker, and no per-account migration flag. All inputs (proof and signature) are plain calldata, visible on-chain the moment the first legitimate redemption is broadcast. setStalk uses `s.accts[account].stalk += accountStalk` and `s.accts[account].roots += accountRoots` (line 205-211), and addMigratedDepositsToAccount re-writes the same deposit slots each call. Because both the proof and the signature re-validate identically on every call, anyone can resubmit the exact observed calldata repeatedly until `deadline`, accumulating stalk and roots to `reciever` on each replay while no L1 backing is consumed (the L1 deposits are not burned per-redemption by this function). The result is unbounded inflation of governance/yield weight (stalk drives Stalk-weighted governance and Silo earnings; roots drive earned-bean distribution) and per-account deposit credit, against the protocol invariant that migrated credit is issued exactly once per L1 owner. This is the access-control failure mode of signature reuse: a one-time authorization is treated as a reusable capability.
impact: Repeated replay of a single legitimate migration's public calldata inflates s.accts[reciever].stalk and s.accts[reciever].roots without bound (and re-credits deposits), corrupting Stalk-weighted governance, Silo earnings, and earned-bean accounting protocol-wide. Conservative reading: unbacked minting of governance weight and yield -> protocol insolvency / governance capture. Immunefi v2.2: protocol insolvency / unbacked value creation = High to Critical; scored High pending PoC of the economic magnitude.

ite.intent: Mint unbacked stalk, roots, and deposit credit to a receiver by reusing a single authorized migration authorization
ite.technique: Replay the publicly visible proof+signature calldata of redeemDepositsAndInternalBalances multiple times before deadline; setStalk uses += and there is no nonce or redeemed-marker, so each replay re-credits the receiver
ite.evasion: Intended protection was the merkle proof + EIP-712 owner signature as a one-time authorization, but neither is consumed; the deadline is the only bound, leaving an open replay window

ice_chain.impact: Inflated governance weight and earned-bean/Silo yield entitlement with no backing; protocol-wide accounting (total stalk vs sum) desynced
ice_chain.consumer_function: Stalk-weighted governance voting and Silo earnings/plenty distribution that read s.accts[account].stalk and .roots (LibSilo / Season sunrise mow + earned bean math)
ice_chain.exploit_path: EOA replays captured calldata -> setStalk += -> inflated stalk/roots -> consumed by governance vote weighting and earned-bean distribution
